title: Answer: intelligence is open, and choice is modeled only on a stand-in

statements.text: Vibe has no settled account of intelligence, and the question is open. What it owes is the structure of experience, which vibes make one self, how unified it is, what it keeps and how it chooses. Choosing is modeled on the deliberation engine, a known attractor model that exhibits the structure of choice but does not derive a self from the base rule. The program measures its grids against the proofs that hyperbolic grids host universal computation.
statements.scope: open. The ledger rows for information and computation are partial or stand-ins, and the working rule forms no self yet
